_note: Skills the catalog ships from a repository other than the primary collection. Each entry names that repository, the directory holding the skill's SKILL.md, and the category Settings groups it under; `scripts/sync-skill-catalog.ts` pins the repository's default-branch commit, packages the directory like any other catalogue skill, and records `<repo>/<path>` as its provenance. An entry ships only when `curation.json` rates it at or above `minValue`, so the reviewed value judgement stays in one file.
